E_C: 2 * E_C0 .* E_Cc .* E_Cphi .* E_Ctheta ./ (E_C0 .* E_Cc .* E_Cphi - E_C0 .* E_Cc .* E_Ctheta + E_C0 .* E_Cphi .* E_Ctheta + E_Cc .* E_Cphi .* E_Ctheta)
2 * E_C0 .* E_Cc .* E_Cphi .* E_Ctheta ./ (E_C0 .* E_Cc .* E_Cphi - E_C0 .* E_Cc .* E_Ctheta + E_C0 .* E_Cphi .* E_Ctheta + E_Cc .* E_Cphi .* E_Ctheta)
_comment: Two symmetric soft zero-pis coupled by circuit (a) of Liu, Weissler, Combes, arXiv:2609.16630v1: the two_zero_pi.json circuit (nodes 1-4 and 5-8, coupler islands 9 and 10) plus C0_<n> from each qubit node 1-8 to ground 0 (none on the coupler islands).

Parameters are the paper's Table I: E_Ctheta, E_Cphi of the uncoupled qubit (C_theta = 2C + 2C_J + C_0, C_phi = 2C_J + C_0), E_Cc of each coupling capacitor, E_C0 of each ground capacitor; E_L shared, E_J1, E_J2. Elements: junction C = ghz_to_farad(2 E_Cphi E_C0/(E_C0 - E_Cphi)), large C = ghz_to_farad(2 E_Ctheta E_Cphi/(E_Cphi - E_Ctheta)), L = ghz_to_henry(E_L).
The coupling g n_theta1 n_theta2 has g = 8 E_C[theta1, theta2]; the coupler also renormalizes E_C[theta_q, theta_q] and E_C[phi_q, phi_q] (paper eq:g_theta and the renormalized charging energies).
Z_full as two_zero_pi.json; non-dynamical: Sigma1 - Sigma2, the coupler-island directions and all-ones (all free).

zeta1, zeta2 are decoupled harmonic modes. Ring flux on the junctions: custom B with +1/2 of the ring flux on each junction and capacitor entries solving G B = I (static flux: a gauge choice; the irrotational B would put it on L<q>b instead, giving flux_linear on phi and zeta).
Sector labels n_g1 (theta1) and n_g3 (theta2) renamed n_g1, n_g2.
